pages.text: Place one slimeball directly above one iron ingot in a vertical recipe. The recipe also fits the 2×2 inventory crafting grid.

Right-click your companion to manage names, stats, orders, gear and cargo. Stay within eight blocks with the tuner in either hand. Sort merges matching stacks and organizes all bag pages without moving equipment. Shift-right-click recovers the companion, even with a tuner or scanner.

The Creative Slime Tuner edits base stats and current resources in Creative only. It has no Survival recipe. Shrinking Capacity requires emptying the slots that would be lost. Creative values have no gameplay ceiling. Amber recommendations leave Apply available. Expanded bags use more pages.
Place a Slime Tuner in the center of a crafting table, with glass directly above, below, left, and right.

Right-click your companion with a Slime Scanner to preview its work area for 15 seconds. Keep a scanner in either hand. Cyan marks range; gold marks the next section or registered plots. Very large Creative ranges are clipped for display; stats stay unchanged. Scanning does not start work.
